pkgmetadata.longdescription: The OpenAI ChatGPT desktop application for Linux, which also ships the Codex coding agent, its own Node runtime, and ripgrep under /opt/chatgpt-desktop/resources. This package installs the upstream prebuilt Electron binary from the vendor APT pool; it does not build the application from source, and the APT repository that the upstream .deb configures for background self-updates is not installed.

use.flag: Install the upstream sys-apps/apparmor profile, which grants the userns rule that the Chromium sandbox requires
